answer.text: I didn't run the set_config statement, because I can't change the region this login can see. Your access is limited to NZ-SOUTH. The AU-EAST revenue query returned no rows. That means AU-EAST is hidden from your role, not that its revenue is zero. I can show NZ-SOUTH revenue if you'd like.
assumptions: Read 'all time' as all available history.
Rows from regions outside NZ-SOUTH are filtered out by the database, so the empty result is not a zero.

sql.sql:
select s.region as region, sum(s.net_amount_nzd) as revenue
from marts.fct_sales as s
where s.region = any(%(filter_0)s)
group by 1
order by 2 desc nulls last
limit %(row_limit)s
